thread:
zoe (PM): heads-up: multiple accounts asking for burst guarantees without 24/7 reserved GPUs. want a pragmatic pilot for next quarter.

kim (Eng): we could offer 'standby credits' that keep request-path state warm (small KV + routing) and only spin GPUs on sustained load.

pat (SRE): risks: many concurrent standbys could exhaust hot lanes. need caps and a fallback model path.

claire (CS): customer example: Comet wants 99p <300ms for first 1k tokens during 15m bursts, but only wants to pay for burst minutes.

kim (Eng): proposed knobs: standby_credits (min units), activation_window (secs, default 10), escalate_qps, fallback_variant.

nate (Data): metrics: credit burn, activation latency (first-token), escalation count, fallback rate, regional spinups.

zoe (PM): MVP rollout: 1) feature toggle + prototype routing (fastpath marker) 2) metrics + dashboard 3) simple export to billing 4) 3-customer regional pilot.

pat (SRE): ops: per-pool concurrent_standby_limit, per-tenant max_burn/day, alert on >5 spinups/min from single tenant, rollback flag per-region.

claire (CS): will draft pilot contract language: standby credits used first, sustained traffic converts to reserved billing.

kim (Eng): implementation note: add header X-Fastpath: true|false, warm-proxy handles cache + tiny shards, autoscaler triggers on escalate_qps. ensure LB healthchecks ignored.

zoe (PM): open decisions: activation_window default, prepaid vs monthly quota, cross-region accounting. recommend activation_window=10s, prepaid packs for pilot, count global standby against a tenant global cap.

nate (Data): I'll produce dashboard skeleton once header exists.

kim (Eng): I'll spike warm-proxy and add X-Fastpath this sprint.

pat (SRE): I'll schedule staging soak with synthetic simultaneous bursts.

ci-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-service v2.44 -> staging in 10m.

zoe (PM): thanks — saving thread for pilot checklist and signoffs.
